This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 10 [[truncated tetrahedron|truncated tetrahedra]], formed by [[Truncation (geometry)|truncating]] each of the tetrahedra in the [[compound of ten tetrahedra|compound of 10 tetrahedra]]. It also results from composing the two enantiomers of the [[compound of five truncated tetrahedra|compound of 5 truncated tetrahedra]]. It could also be called a truncated icosicosahedron.

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the even permutations of

: (±1, ±1, ±3)
: (±τ<sup>−1</sup>, ±(−τ<sup>−2</sup>), ±2τ)
: (±τ, ±(−2τ<sup>−1</sup>), ±τ<sup>2</sup>)
: (±τ<sup>2</sup>, ±(−τ<sup>−2</sup>), ±2)
: (±(2τ−1), ±1, ±(2τ − 1))

where τ = (1+{{radic|5}})/2 is the [[golden ratio]] (sometimes written φ).
